Horror/Wep_Rifle_01.name: Rifle 01
Horror/Wep_Rifle_01.description: A service rifle from a mining charter, not a military one. Worn where hands go, spotless everywhere else.

Horror/Wep_Flamethrower_01.name: Flamethrower 01
Horror/Wep_Flamethrower_01.description: Rated for clearing fungal growth out of ducting. Nobody asked what else it had been used on.

Horror/Wep_Laser_Cutter_01.name: Laser Cutter 01
Horror/Wep_Laser_Cutter_01.description: A hull cutter. Slow, silent, and it does not care what the hull is made of.

Horror/Wep_Mining_Laser_01.name: Mining Laser 01
Horror/Wep_Mining_Laser_01.description: Industrial rock laser. The battery is the heavy part, and it is worn on the back.

Horror/Wep_Blow_Torch_01.name: Blow Torch 01
Horror/Wep_Blow_Torch_01.description: Cutting torch. Short reach, and it ruins whatever it touches.

Horror/Wep_Welder_01.name: Welder 01
Horror/Wep_Welder_01.description: Arc welder. Repairs a bulkhead, or argues with something on the other side of it.

Horror/Wep_Drill_01.name: Drill 01
Horror/Wep_Drill_01.description: Core drill. Two hands, and a wind-up long enough to regret.

Horror/Wep_Axe_01.name: Axe 01
Horror/Wep_Axe_01.description: Emergency axe off a bulkhead mount. Every deck has one and nobody logs them.

Horror/Wep_Hammer_01.name: Hammer 01
Horror/Wep_Hammer_01.description: A mallet for seating deck plate. Unsubtle, and entirely effective.

Horror/Wep_Knife_01.name: Knife 01
Horror/Wep_Knife_01.description: A working knife. Line, tape, rations, and whatever else the day turns up.

Horror/Wep_Wrench_01.name: Wrench 01
Horror/Wep_Wrench_01.description: Pipe wrench, adjustable, heavy at the head. The oldest weapon on this list by several centuries.

Horror/Wep_Shock_Stick_01.name: Shock Stick 01
Horror/Wep_Shock_Stick_01.description: Livestock prod, repurposed. The charge light is the only part that still works reliably.

Horror/Wep_Surgical_Tool_01.name: Surgical Tool 01
Horror/Wep_Surgical_Tool_01.description: A surgical instrument, sterile and very sharp. Found a long way from any surgery.

Horror/Wep_Surgical_Tool_02.name: Surgical Tool 02
Horror/Wep_Surgical_Tool_02.description: The second instrument from the same tray. The tray is not aboard.

Police/Wep_Pistol_01.name: Pistol 01
Police/Wep_Pistol_01.description: Issue sidearm, polymer frame, fifteen rounds. Every one of these has a serial and most of them still match a record.

Police/Wep_Revolver_01.name: Revolver 01
Police/Wep_Revolver_01.description: Six-shot revolver. Older than the department that issued it and never once jammed.

Police/Wep_Rifle_01.name: Rifle 01
Police/Wep_Rifle_01.description: Patrol carbine with a light and a reflex sight. Kept in the car, signed out by the shift.

Police/Wep_Shotgun_01.name: Shotgun 01
Police/Wep_Shotgun_01.description: Pump shotgun with a light under the barrel and shells on the stock. Doors, mostly.

Police/Wep_DoubleBarrel_01.name: DoubleBarrel 01
Police/Wep_DoubleBarrel_01.description: Side-by-side twelve gauge. Came in as evidence and stayed as something else.

Police/Wep_Sniper_01.name: Sniper 01
Police/Wep_Sniper_01.description: Bolt-action marksman rifle with a scope and a bipod. Signed for by name, always.

Police/Wep_Launcher_01.name: Launcher 01
Police/Wep_Launcher_01.description: Forty-millimetre launcher, single shot. Fires gas, smoke and the occasional thing it should not.

Police/Wep_Stungun_01.name: Stungun 01
Police/Wep_Stungun_01.description: Dart taser. Two wires, one cartridge, and a long form to fill in afterwards.

Police/Wep_Stungun_02.name: Stungun 02
Police/Wep_Stungun_02.description: Contact stun gun. Has to touch you, and then it does.

Police/Wep_Stun_Baton_01.name: Stun Baton 01
Police/Wep_Stun_Baton_01.description: Stun baton. A stick, and then a stick with a charge in it.

Police/Wep_Baton_01.name: Baton 01
Police/Wep_Baton_01.description: Side-handle baton. Cheap, hard, and on every belt in the building.

Police/Wep_Baton_02.name: Baton 02
Police/Wep_Baton_02.description: Collapsible baton. Fits in a pocket; does not feel like it when it opens.

Police/Wep_Door_Ram_01.name: Door Ram 01
Police/Wep_Door_Ram_01.description: Breaching ram. Sixteen kilos of steel with handles, for doors that will not be talked to.

SciFiCity/Wep_Pistol_01.name: Pistol 01
SciFiCity/Wep_Pistol_01.description: City-issue sidearm. Polymer, boxy, and everywhere.

SciFiCity/Wep_Revolver_01.name: Revolver 01
SciFiCity/Wep_Revolver_01.description: Heavy revolver with a long barrel. Makes a point, then a hole.

SciFiCity/Wep_MachinePistol_Gen1_01.name: MachinePistol Gen1 01
SciFiCity/Wep_MachinePistol_Gen1_01.description: First-generation machine pistol. Loud, cheap, and it climbs.

SciFiCity/Wep_MachinePistol_Gen2_01.name: MachinePistol Gen2 01
SciFiCity/Wep_MachinePistol_Gen2_01.description: Second-generation machine pistol. The recoil went into a spring; the price went up.

SciFiCity/Wep_SMG_01.name: SMG 01
SciFiCity/Wep_SMG_01.description: Compact sub-machine gun with a folding stock. The security firms buy them by the crate.

SciFiCity/Wep_Rifle_Small_01.name: Rifle Small 01
SciFiCity/Wep_Rifle_Small_01.description: Short carbine. Fits in a car door and out of it in one movement.

SciFiCity/Wep_Rifle_Base_01.name: Rifle Base 01
SciFiCity/Wep_Rifle_Base_01.description: The base rifle the city builds everything else on. Rails top and bottom.

SciFiCity/Wep_Rifle_Laser_01.name: Rifle Laser 01
SciFiCity/Wep_Rifle_Laser_01.description: Laser rifle with a battery in the stock. Silent, hot, and it leaves a line in the smoke.

SciFiCity/Wep_Rifle_Plasma_01.name: Rifle Plasma 01
SciFiCity/Wep_Rifle_Plasma_01.description: Plasma rifle, first pattern. The coils glow before it fires and for a while after.

SciFiCity/Wep_Rifle_Plasma_02.name: Rifle Plasma 02
SciFiCity/Wep_Rifle_Plasma_02.description: Plasma rifle, second pattern. Cooler running; the same argument.

SciFiCity/Wep_Rifle_Plasma_03.name: Rifle Plasma 03
SciFiCity/Wep_Rifle_Plasma_03.description: Plasma rifle, third pattern, with a drum feed. Corporate security only, in theory.

SciFiCity/Wep_Shotgun_Plasma_01.name: Shotgun Plasma 01
SciFiCity/Wep_Shotgun_Plasma_01.description: Plasma shotgun. A wide cone of something that used to be gas.

SciFiCity/Wep_Sniper_01.name: Sniper 01
SciFiCity/Wep_Sniper_01.description: Bolt-action marksman rifle with a long scope. Rooftops.

SciFiCity/Wep_Sniper_Plasma_02.name: Sniper Plasma 02
SciFiCity/Wep_Sniper_Plasma_02.description: Plasma marksman rifle. One bolt, a long way, and a flash on the far end.

SciFiCity/Wep_Syringe_Gun_01.name: Syringe Gun 01
SciFiCity/Wep_Syringe_Gun_01.description: Syringe gun off a medical cart. What it loads is up to whoever holds it.

SciFiCity/Wep_Knife_01.name: Knife 01
SciFiCity/Wep_Knife_01.description: Combat knife. Clean edge, taped grip.

SciFiCity/Wep_Shiv_01.name: Shiv 01
SciFiCity/Wep_Shiv_01.description: A shiv. Something that was not a knife until somebody needed one.

SciFiCity/Wep_Sword_01.name: Sword 01
SciFiCity/Wep_Sword_01.description: A straight sword with a powered edge. Ornamental, according to the licence.

_stance: A weapon names a stance, never an animation. A stance is a folder of clips under /Game/Characters/Animations/Lyra/<Stance>/ named <MM|MF>_<Stance>_<Clip>; the game composes that path rather than looking anything up. See Docs/HeldAssetStandard.md part 3.

Pistol._carry: where the grip sits in the eye frame (x forward, y right, z up, cm) per posture: arms out for a pistol; a first guess, tune in play
Pistol._ads: the rear sight this far out from the eye, on the eye line, down the sights: arm's length for a pistol (a rifle keeps the character default at the cheek)

Pistol1H._note: one-handed pistol: the Pistol clips (fallback) applied from the right clavicle down, so only the gun arm takes the hold and the other arm keeps the body’s own motion; not two-handed, so no support hand reaches for it; carried 6 cm further right than the two-handed hold, in line with the shoulder rather than the chest -- a first guess, tune in play
Pistol1H._ads: the rear sight this far out from the eye, on the eye line, down the sights: arm's length for a pistol (a rifle keeps the character default at the cheek)

stances._elbow_down: 0..1: how far the hand IK pulls the elbows toward down-and-out from the clip's own bend; pistols hold the arms out and want it, rifles keep the clip's elbows
stances._grip_nudge: x forward, y right, z up, cm, in the weapon frame: moves where the trigger hand closes for every weapon on the stance. Pistols: the hand up the grip, under the slide (a first guess; tune in play)
stances._clips: a clip name (Idle_Hipfire, Idle_ADS, Equip, Reload) -> an asset path, used before the Lyra folder; the Blade stance rests on the sword set's own idle

_stance_by_kind: Which stance each catalogue kind uses. An individual weapon may override it with its own 'stance' field.
_optics: Optics that can be fitted to a weapon. A weapon naming one in its 'optic' field mounts it at 'optic_mount' (its own space) and AIMS THROUGH IT: the lens centre replaces the weapon's rear sight, so the ADS solve needs no special case. Fitted by Tools/fit_optics.py.

Lens_Small.name: Built-in lens
Lens_Small.comment: Tools/make_lens_optic.py: a glass disc for a scope that is part of its weapon

_optics_kind: red_dot | zoomed | scope -- see Tools/set_optic_kinds.py. red_dot: 1x, no overlay. zoomed: magnified, no overlay, no black surround, weapon stays visible. scope: tube hidden from its owner, circular opening over a blacked-out view, world narrowed by the magnification.
_optic_fixed: true = the sight is built into the weapon and cannot be swapped; see Tools/set_optic_fixed.py. Reading it is normal, only changing it is refused.
_optics_pip: true = picture-in-picture: a second scene render shown in the glass, instead of narrowing the world and masking it. The ALTERNATIVE to "kind": "scope" behaviour, not an addition. Costs a full extra scene render while the sight is up. See ABaseCharacter::TickOpticPiP.
